leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a route tree data structure to represent hierarchical navigation paths
Implement a recursive function to traverse the route tree and extract breadcrumb data
Manipulate the extracted data to format breadcrumb labels and URLs
Initialize and render a breadcrumb component with the generated navigation links
Configure the breadcrumb generator to handle dynamic route changes
Integrate the breadcrumb component into a navigation system
Apply the breadcrumb generator to different route tree structures
lessonTitle: Build breadcrumb generator from route tree
